title: Cereal Bar Mod
description: This mod adds a simple cereal bar
body:
🥣 Cereal Bar Mod

A simple, cozy food addition for Minecraft.

Cereal Bar Mod adds a single new item: the Cereal Bar — a quick, tasty snack designed to fit naturally into vanilla survival gameplay.

✨ Features

🥣 Cereal Bar Food Item
A new craftable food that restores hunger quickly and is perfect for early-game survival or quick adventures.

⚙️ Simple & Vanilla-Friendly
No complex systems, no extra mechanics — just a clean addition to Minecraft’s food variety.

🔥 Balanced Gameplay
Designed to feel useful without replacing existing foods or breaking progression.

🧩 Why this mod?

Minecraft food can feel repetitive. The Cereal Bar adds a small but satisfying new option for players who want a bit more variety without changing the core survival experience.

📦 Compatibility
Works with Forge/Fabric (depending on version)
Survival and multiplayer compatible
No dependencies required
💬 Feedback

Suggestions or improvements are welcome!
